title: Colours sampled from a reference are sRGB; materials want linear
summary: Material and shader colours are LINEAR: (1, .46, .05) renders pale peach. Convert reference samples: sRGB (230, 95, 20) = linear (.78, .12, .008).

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: new THREE.Color().setStyle('#e65f14', THREE.SRGBColorSpace)   // = fromRef() in module.recon.canvas-materials

doc.when: Every colour picked from a reference image and used in a shader vec3 or a material.
doc.avoid: Typing sampled 0-255 values /255 into vec3()/Color(r, g, b).
gotchas: Hex numbers passed to THREE.Color(0xrrggbb) are treated as sRGB and converted; raw floats and shader vec3 are not.

problem.symptom: A colour picked from the reference comes out much paler/yellower.
problem.cause: Floats in materials/shaders are linear; the sample was sRGB.
problem.fix: Convert sRGB -> linear (setStyle with SRGBColorSpace, or ((c+.055)/1.055)^2.4).
problem.detect: Region means of the element vs the reference differ mostly in G and B.
